## Goal

This completed file is for instructor reference or post-workshop release.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
```

## Import

```{r}
health_raw <- read_csv("data/bootcamp_health.csv")
glimpse(health_raw)
```

## Inspect

```{r}
dim(health_raw)
head(health_raw)

health_raw |>
  summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_count") |>
  arrange(desc(missing_count))
```

## Clean and create variables

```{r}
health_clean <- health_raw |>
  mutate(
    visit_date = as.Date(visit_date),
    hypertension_flag = systolic_bp >= 130 | diastolic_bp >= 80,
    bmi_group = case_when(
      is.na(bmi) ~ NA_character_,
      bmi < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
      bmi < 25 ~ "Healthy range",
      bmi < 30 ~ "Overweight",
      TRUE ~ "Obesity range"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(bmi), !is.na(systolic_bp))
```

## Summarize

```{r}
health_clean |>
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_age = mean(age),
    mean_bmi = mean(bmi),
    percent_hypertension = mean(hypertension_flag) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Plot

```{r}
health_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bmi, y = systolic_bp, color = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Systolic blood pressure tends to increase with BMI",
    subtitle = "Simulated teaching data; not real participant records",
    x = "Body mass index",
    y = "Systolic blood pressure",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
health_clean |>
  count(bmi_group) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bmi_group, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Participants by BMI group",
    x = "BMI group",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Simple model

```{r}
fit <- lm(systolic_bp ~ age + bmi + sex, data = health_clean)
summary(fit)
```

```{r}
tidy(fit)
glance(fit)
```

## Save one output

```{r}
cohort_table <- health_clean |>
  group_by(sex) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    mean_bmi = mean(bmi),
    mean_sbp = mean(systolic_bp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(cohort_table, "output/cohort_table.csv")
```
